# Accessibility

Accessibility is decided when the markup is written; retrofitted later it costs ten times as much.

Marker after the identifier: a tool name = tooled constraint (the build or the commit fails); `guidance` = rule of conduct checked in review.

## Base rules

### Rules

- **CORE-030** · `jsx-a11y` — The native element comes first (`button`, `a`, `input`, `dialog`); a `role` is added only when no native element fits.
  Why: Native elements bring keyboard behaviour, focus and semantics for free.
- **CORE-031** · `jsx-a11y` — Every form control has a visible label associated by `htmlFor` and `id`.
  Why: A placeholder is not a label; it disappears as soon as the user types.
- **CORE-032** · `jsx-a11y` — Every image carries an `alt`; a decorative image carries `alt=""`.
  Why: A missing `alt` makes a screen reader announce the file name.
- **CORE-033** · guidance — Text keeps a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background, 3:1 for text of 24px or bolder.
  Why: Below that, the screen becomes unreadable outdoors and for a large part of users.
- **CORE-034** · guidance — An interactive target measures at least 44 by 44 pixels, padding included.
  Why: Below that size a touch screen turns every tap into a lottery.
- **CORE-035** · `jsx-a11y` — No positive `tabIndex`; the focus order follows the DOM order.
  Why: A hand-made focus order breaks at the first inserted element.
- **CORE-036** · `stylelint` — Animations and transitions are neutralised under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
  Why: Motion causes real discomfort for part of the users; the preference is theirs.
- **CORE-037** · guidance — A status or error message is announced through `role="alert"` or an `aria-live` region, never by colour alone.
  Why: A user who does not see the colour must still receive the information.
- **CORE-038** · guidance — A modal traps focus while open and returns it to the element that opened it when closed.
  Why: Without it a keyboard user is left navigating the page behind the dialog.

### Anti-patterns

- **CORE-AP-030** · guidance — Signalling an invalid field with a red border only.
  Why: The information is invisible to a colour-blind user and to a screen reader.
  Instead: Add a text message linked to the field and announced in a live region.
